foundation_contract: F12-interfaces.md r3.2 plus F12b corrections: consumption/auth/lease, immutable persistence, selected-origin internal helpers, editor and source serializers exist. Complete context authoring/review/native/session endpoints and runtime qualification are not provided.
historical_report: e2e/benchmarks/context-hub/baseline-report.json is the retained r3.1 baseline, not current qualification
report_compatibility: Retain r3.1 runs unchanged. Reports without an initial-condition comparison contract and ledger registration cannot be retroactively upgraded into r3.2 comparisons.
comparison_command: node e2e/benchmarks/context-hub/cli.mjs compare OURS.json COMPETITOR.json REVIEW.json OUTPUT.json
comparison_protocol: r3.2: initial conditions are part of the ledger-bound comparison identity; J5 cold_adoption/recurring_rollout/recovery never pool; shared/automatic stage coverage is independent of action counting; required human decisions remain measured
driver_export: async createDriver({jobId, runId, registration}) -> {mode, provenance, perform, observe, teardown}

driver_contract.perform: async perform(stage, {ledger, signal}); drive only frozen public UI/CLI interfaces; instrument every meaningful primitive plus S/H/R separately. Mechanical stages may share a completed same-phase action through ledger.stage or supply independent automatic evidence. Honor stage.human_actions and cancellation.
driver_contract.observe: async observe(check, {signal}) -> {source, value, artifact_sha256}; read independent API/PG/filesystem/model-boundary/external evidence, never a product toast
driver_contract.teardown: async teardown() -> {qualified}; qualified only after owned resources are cancelled, settled or explicitly uncertain, terminated and destruction verified
driver_contract.raw_evidence: Raw customer evidence stays in separately authorized redacted artifacts; the ledger retains opaque IDs and hashes only
driver_contract.comparator: Use the strongest applicable customer-configured workflow; independent review receipt binds both ledger hashes. Documentation and synthetic runs cannot establish a ratio.

harness_interfaces: ActionLedger.stage({step,phase,source,artifactHash,actionSequences:[]}) records independent completion without fabricating an operator action; the runner binds preregistration before any action

operational_matrix.oracle: same durable job/workflow, one accepted dispatch
same workflow identity; no duplicate provider request
older generation cannot overwrite result or release live sender
zero provider requests; provably unsent allowance released
retain completed/unknown spend; no false cancellation of provider work
one workspace period authority; no independent remaining balances
unknown charge remains in original period and holds live-sender capacity
all Simulation/trace/artifact/export projections inaccessible after scoped clock expiry
if assistance ever enables, recover original key/job with no second paid generation

integration_blockers: Complete downstream context authoring/review/native/session public interfaces; F12b does not expose them
Product test-image-only scoped clock/cache/quota and owned-worker barriers; existing v1.1 programmable transport alone is insufficient
Concrete round-3 browser flow approvals with usable routes, serializer pins and locators; the supplied approval document covers only SKILLS-E2E-001 through 003, no round-3 IDs are reserved
Actual Simulation launch/ingestion path and private-native/shared-budget controls
Released SDK/application wheel and npm artifacts with hashes; actual native binaries and observable delivery
Customer environment, retained external tracing/CI access, independent competitor reviewer and measured comparator runs
Checkpoint P before J5 campaigns; separately authorized bounded real-GitHub conformance
limitations: No new round-3 browser flows or FLOWS.md edits: concrete round-3 approvals and complete dependent public surfaces are absent; the three existing Skills flows are inherited foundation work
44 one-sided oracle self-tests prove harness fallibility, not backend product coverage
Provider/Git fixtures do not qualify real provider transport, permissions, GitHub semantics or business behavior
Worker barriers/clock are injection primitives, not production state mutations or an alternative scheduler
Native preflight qualifies topology/pins only; it does not launch a guest or manufacture release evidence
Cold/configured measurements, failed attempts and human review remain separate; no overall 10x claim
